sprint_name: Live Capture Preflight, Snapshot Ownership & Controlled Activation Readiness

existing_capture_architecture_audit.snapshot_reader_identity: FactualMarketDataAdapter (Market Intelligence API / Web Service / UI)
existing_capture_architecture_audit.snapshot_ownership: Dedicated capture worker owns write permissions; web service only reads
existing_capture_architecture_audit.expected_permissions: User 1000:1000, read_only container root (true), dedicated volume :rw for capture worker, web server :ro
existing_capture_architecture_audit.data_flow: Binance Spot WebSocket kline -> BinanceSpotCandleValidator (is_closed=True) -> MarketDataGapDetector -> RawMarketEvidenceStore (SHA-256) -> AtomicSnapshotIO.atomic_write -> live_market_state.json / btcusdt_factual_latest.json -> FactualMarketDataAdapter.safe_read (1s TTL cache) -> /api/v1/intelligence/market-overview -> Module A UI
existing_capture_architecture_audit.atomic_replacement: AtomicSnapshotIO.atomic_write writes to adjacent .tmp.<pid>, flushes, fsyncs, and atomically renames via os.replace
existing_capture_architecture_audit.torn_read_prevention: Complete protection; readers observe either previous complete JSON or new complete JSON, never partial data

existing_passive_capture_deployment.production_status: UNVERIFIED_PRODUCTION_STATE (Offline inspection only; VPS access prohibited)

network_boundaries.inbound: Port 8000 (HTTP read-only) behind reverse proxy (Coolify/Nginx). Capture worker has ports: [] (0 exposed)
network_boundaries.outbound: Capture worker requires outbound HTTPS/WSS to public stream.binance.com:9443 and api.binance.com:443. Web server requires zero outbound network

volume_mounts.shared_snapshot_integration: cbe_080_live_capture_data mountable as :ro on web service for direct zero-latency snapshot reading

relevant_feature_flags.CBE_APPROVAL_3_AUTHORIZED: false (Default fail-closed, required true for live collection)

snapshot_compatibility_and_provenance.open_vs_closed_semantics: Strictly closed candles only (x=True). Unclosed candles rejected at validator and reader schema gates
snapshot_compatibility_and_provenance.utc_timestamps: ISO 8601 UTC with explicit millisecond parity and boundary validation
snapshot_compatibility_and_provenance.atomicity_guarantee: os.replace on same volume mount ensures POSIX atomic swap
snapshot_compatibility_and_provenance.freshness_evaluation: 30-minute boundary; future clock skew > 60s flagged FUTURE_SKEW
snapshot_compatibility_and_provenance.classification_distinction: Explicitly separates HISTORICAL_SNAPSHOT from verified LIVE_OBSERVED

results.2_delayed_candle: PASSED (Evaluated correctly as STALE when > 30m, BOUNDARY_STALE at 30m, FRESH when < 30m)
results.3_missing_candle: PASSED (Gap of 600s detected, missing 1 bar reported, research eligibility gated)

results.6_corrupt_snapshot: PASSED (safe_read caught JSONDecodeError, adapter fell back to canonical frozen baseline with note)
results.7_unavailable_capture_writer: PASSED (Missing file handled gracefully via canonical baseline fallback, zero crash)
results.8_stale_heartbeat: PASSED (Heartbeat > 120s flagged not fresh, None/invalid handled safely)
results.9_source_identity_mismatch: PASSED (Non-Binance source like KRAKEN rejected by schema validation)
results.10_read_only_api_consumer: PASSED (Endpoint returned factual data without triggering model inference or trading, prospective files untouched)

resource_and_reliability_assessment.incremental_cpu_use: < 0.05 CPU idle, < 0.10 peak (throttled to 0.25 CFS quota)
resource_and_reliability_assessment.incremental_ram_use: 35-50 MB RSS (budget 150 MB, hard container ceiling 300 MB)
resource_and_reliability_assessment.snapshot_write_frequency: 1 write per 5-minute interval (288 writes/day) + periodic heartbeat
resource_and_reliability_assessment.filesystem_io: ~450 KB / day total write (~350 bytes append + ~1.2 KB atomic snapshot)
resource_and_reliability_assessment.api_read_frequency: Throttled by 1.0s TTL in-memory cache to <= 1 read/sec from disk
resource_and_reliability_assessment.failure_recovery: Automatic reconnect loop with exponential backoff on transport drop; REST gap recovery for sequence jumps
resource_and_reliability_assessment.reconnection_behavior: Clean transport reconnect with cryptographic hash chain continuity check before resuming append
resource_and_reliability_assessment.duplicate_ingestion_risk: MITIGATED (Single-writer model; container singularity ensures zero duplicate exchange connections)

security_audit.credentials_required: NONE (Public market data only; zero API keys or secrets in env/code)
security_audit.outbound_network_scope: Strictly limited to stream.binance.com:9443 (WSS) and api.binance.com:443 (HTTPS)
security_audit.filesystem_write_permissions: Container root filesystem read_only: true, user 1000:1000, write access limited to /tmp (64MB noexec) and /app/data/live_capture
security_audit.snapshot_consumer_permissions: Read-only API server requires only :ro access to snapshot directory
security_audit.service_isolation: Capture worker and web server decoupled via filesystem snapshot; zero IPC, zero shared memory
security_audit.read_only_api_behavior: All /api/v1/intelligence/* endpoints are HTTP GET only (mutations return 405 Method Not Allowed)
security_audit.rate_limiting: 60 req/min per IP at reverse proxy level
security_audit.error_handling: Strict fail-closed architecture with zero stack trace leakage to API responses
security_audit.feature_flag_defaults: All live flags default to false (CBE_APPROVAL_3_AUTHORIZED=false, CBE_BINANCE_COLLECTION_ENABLED=false)

controlled_activation_runbook.step_01: Read-Only Production-State Verification: SSH to host, run `docker ps -a` to inspect existing containers; check port 8000 and any active workers. STOP & AWAIT APPROVAL.
controlled_activation_runbook.step_02: Confirm Active Capture: Inspect `/app/data/live_capture/raw_market/raw_candles_BTCUSDT_5m.jsonl` mtime. If active and updating, record ALREADY_ACTIVE and DO NOT start another worker. STOP & AWAIT APPROVAL.
controlled_activation_runbook.step_03: Enforce Single-Writer Invariant: Verify container_name singularity `cbe_080_coolify_live_capture` and PID lock before launching. STOP & AWAIT APPROVAL.
controlled_activation_runbook.step_04: Confirm Snapshot Compatibility: Verify schema version (1.0.0), symbol (BTCUSDT), interval (5m), and volume mount permissions (`chmod 644`). STOP & AWAIT APPROVAL.
controlled_activation_runbook.step_05: Verify Safety Interlocks: Pre-flight verify CBE_TRADING_DISABLED=true, CBE_PROSPECTIVE_OBSERVATION_ENABLED=false, CBE_APPROVAL_4_AUTHORIZED=false. STOP & AWAIT APPROVAL.
controlled_activation_runbook.step_06: Minimal Production Delta: Deploy ONLY the isolated `cbe-080-live-capture` container. Do NOT redeploy database or web server. STOP & AWAIT APPROVAL.
controlled_activation_runbook.step_07: Validate First Observed Closed Candle: Tail logs for 5m (`docker logs -f cbe_080_coolify_live_capture`); verify `is_closed=True`, evidence append, and atomic snapshot write. STOP & AWAIT APPROVAL.
controlled_activation_runbook.step_08: Verify Freshness & Heartbeat Independently: Call `/api/v1/intelligence/freshness`; verify freshness_status==FRESH and spot price matches public Binance Spot (+/- 0.1%). STOP & AWAIT APPROVAL.
controlled_activation_runbook.step_09: Resource Verification: Run `docker stats cbe_080_coolify_live_capture --no-stream`; confirm CPU < 10%, RAM < 150 MB. STOP & AWAIT APPROVAL.
controlled_activation_runbook.step_10: Rollback Plan: If crash loop, RSS > 250 MB, or gap > 3 bars occurs, execute `docker stop cbe_080_coolify_live_capture`, fall back to canonical baseline snapshot, notify operator. STOP & AWAIT APPROVAL.
controlled_activation_runbook.step_11: Operator Sign-Off: Hard stop at every phase transition; no automated continuation without explicit confirmation.

rollback_criteria: Container crash loop or process restart > 2 times in 1 hour.
Memory consumption exceeding 250 MB RSS (ceiling 300 MB).
Unrecovered candle sequence gaps exceeding 3 bars (> 15 minutes).
Any attempt to invoke model scoring or order execution (instant emergency termination).

required_authorizations.1_read_only_vps_inspection: Authorization to inspect running containers and disk states on production VPS.
required_authorizations.2_public_binance_spot_ingestion: Authorization to connect to public Binance WebSocket/REST endpoints for BTCUSDT 5m candles.
required_authorizations.3_production_worker_deployment: Authorization to start/restart cbe-080-live-capture container on Coolify.
required_authorizations.4_market_intelligence_deployment: Authorization to mount shared snapshot volume to web server and expose /intelligence UI.
required_authorizations.5_prospective_model_scoring: STRICTLY PROHIBITED (Requires separate formal APPROVAL 4 protocol).
required_authorizations.6_trading_and_order_execution: PERMANENTLY PROHIBITED (APPROVAL4 = FALSE, zero trading capability).
